subject.title: [Bug] "Cannot convert undefined or null to object" in 2026.3.2 with google-vertex/gemini-3.1-pro-preview

question: Should maintainers require redacted live Vertex/Gemini CLI proof for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/83991 before merging the sanitizer slice, or accept the source-level proof with an explicit override?
rationale: The source path is clear and the patch is narrow, but the affected route is credentialed external provider behavior and the repository policy treats live provider proof as important.

options.title: Require live provider proof
options.body: Keep the sanitizer PR open until redacted exact-head Vertex or Gemini CLI output shows the fixed route succeeds.

options.title: Accept proof override
options.body: A Google provider owner can intentionally merge the source-level sanitizer fix with an explicit proof override while leaving auth-stack follow-up work open.

options.title: Consolidate broader repair
options.body: Pause the sanitizer PR only if maintainers want one combined Google Vertex auth/setup/gaxios landing path instead of a scoped fix.

recommendation.title: Require live provider proof
recommendation.body: Keep the sanitizer PR open until redacted exact-head Vertex or Gemini CLI output shows the fixed route succeeds.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest inspected history on the shared Google thinking helper boundary and is already tied to adjacent Vertex provider work.
